newsitem.title: USA: Maine state employees ratify two-year contract.
newsitem.headline: Maine state employees ratify two-year contract.

text.p: The director of Maine's largest state employees' union said members approved a new two-year contract that includes two-percent raises for both years as well as a lump sum payment.

Gov. Angus King is expected to announce on Wednesday a new, two-year budget that seeks to close an estimated $200 million to $400 million shortfall, and state workers have been concerned about how the Administration was planning to cut costs.

The new contract for the Maine State Employees Association covers about 9,000 workers in four of the union's five bargaining units, and the union's members have been without a contract since July of last year.
